questions.prompt: How should the median be read when the heaps have equal sizes?

choices.label: Average the largest lower-half value and the smallest upper-half value.
choices.feedback: For an even count, the median is the average of the two central values.

choices.label: Average the sums of all values in the two heaps.
choices.feedback: For an even count, the median is the average of the two central values.
